scope: V3 bounded40m-road pilot plus small existing apartment/tree-contact pockets; no full-map rollout.
authoring: Offline LCG + warped multiscale value-noise rejection, exact exported road unions and terrain triangles; no runtime RNG.

distribution.moisture: Existing hydrology excludes wet ground; pilot is dry, so no invented moisture simulation.
distribution.material: Road union and far-road soil control roadside density; foundation/tree context creates secondary sheltered pockets.

exclusions.contract: V3 clearance values apply only to generated rows; retained coordinates/tints are kept from the Phase8 source. Blade geometry may change to the matching V3 silhouette.
